name: Swadloon

attacks.name: Protect
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent’s next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavor:
Swadloon wraps itself in leaves for protection.
It uses the two leaves atop its head to detect air
movements and feel out its surroundings.

pokedex.text: NO. 0541 Leaf-Wrapped Pokémon HT: 1'8" WT: 16.1 lbs.
